oldtownNote: Positions in the Old Town are approximate: please send a Google Maps pin for the exact meeting point at the Hamam.

places.name: Mostar
places.text: Mirna’s home town and the start of every tour: the Old Bridge, the Old Town and the emerald Neretva.

places.name: Blagaj
places.text: The Buna River rises from a karst spring beneath a high rock face, right next to the historic Dervish Tekke.

places.name: Žitomislić
places.text: An Orthodox monastery from the 16th century on the left bank of the Neretva, a quiet stop between Blagaj and Počitelj.
notes: New stop from Mirna’s route: please confirm the text and how long the stop takes.

places.name: Počitelj
places.text: A historic stone village climbing the hillside above the Neretva, with a fortress tower and views over the river valley.

places.label: l
places.name: Kravice Waterfalls
places.text: A wide horseshoe of waterfalls on the Trebižat River, with paths around the falls and the lake below.

places.label: l
places.name: Mogorjelo
places.text: The remains of a Roman villa near Čapljina, an optional stop on the Herzegovina day tour.

places.name: Stolac
places.text: An old town on the Bregava River with stone houses, mills and centuries of history. Ask about a visit.

places.label: l
places.name: Radimlja
places.text: A necropolis of medieval stećci tombstones near Stolac, one of the sites on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Ask about a visit.

places.name: Jablanica Lake
places.text: A long turquoise lake on the Neretva north of Mostar. Boat tours on request.

places.name: Sarajevo
places.text: The capital of Bosnia and Herzegovina, about two hours north of Mostar by road. Day trips on request.

places.name: Hamam
places.text: The old Ottoman bath house in the heart of the Old Town, where the walk begins.

places.name: Kriva ćuprija
places.text: The Crooked Bridge: a small single-arch stone bridge over the Radobolja stream.

places.name: Stari Most & towers
places.text: The Old Bridge, built in 1566 and rebuilt in 2004, guarded by the Halebija and Tara towers. Home of the divers.

places.name: Kujundžiluk
places.text: The old bazaar street, named after the coppersmiths who worked here, paved with river stones.

places.name: Koski Mehmed-pašina džamija
places.text: The mosque with the best-known view of the Old Bridge from its courtyard by the river.
